question: The HIV virus destroys ________ thus weakening the immunity of a person.
solution:
The correct answer is** __lymphocytes__**__.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **When HIV infection destroys lymphocytes, it weakens the body's immune system, which protects against many infections and cancers.**
 
• Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) is a chronic, potentially life-threatening condition caused by the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). 
 
• By damaging your immune system, HIV interferes with your body's ability to fight infection, and diseases weakening is part of the reason that the body is unable to eliminate HIV infection once it has started.
 
• HIV (human immunodeficiency virus) is a retrovirus that attacks the immune system.
 
• Most people who are diagnosed early and take medicines for HIV can live long, healthy lives.
 
• HIV destroys T lymphocytes (helper T cells).
 
• Helper T cells are crucial for immune system function and activate after encountering antigens from disease-causing microorganisms 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c51dd93e10a1f2cca801228ba2f0e70854b2b758c7f7ae4013aa975272bf6e02.png] 

 
• **HIV finds the white blood cells, called lymphocytes cells.**
 
• **HIV gets inside the T cell and makes copies of itself. **
 
• Then, HIV kills the lymphocytes and the new HIV copies find other lymphocytes cells to get inside and start the cycle again. 
 
• HIV kills immune system cells that help the body fight infections and diseases.
 
• HIV infects a type of white blood cell in the body's immune system called a T-helper cell (also called a CD4 cell). 
 
• These vital cells keep us healthy by fighting off infections and diseases. 
 
• HIV cannot reproduce on its own. 
 
• Instead, the virus attaches itself to a T-helper cell and fuses with it
